scope: Java reference characterization and Rust validator qualification before gameplay port

ingress_levels.proof: native window input, focus and real client handlers
same client window/input/Screen event route, consumption witnessed
client gameplay controller and normal network, excluding key/widget dispatch
administrative fixture or component rule only

scenarios.name: Player places a machine and opens its menu
scenarios.setup_provenance: Administratively set up only terrain, game mode and starting items; the machine under test does not exist in the world before the click.
sequence: p1: wait for chunks to be applied and select the hotbar item
p1: aim at the surface and press/release use through the real queue
barrier: input consumed, placement applied on the server and block replicated
p1: aim at the placed machine and press/release use
barrier: menu open on the client and container associated with the same block on the server
hypotheses_to_characterize: placement uses the action's face/orientation
opening the menu does not place a second machine
negative_controls: directing input to another instance must fail because the witness is missing
an old screenshot does not satisfy the current-frame requirement
setBlock fallback must be rejected at this level
scenarios.completion: placement and menu have a complete causal chain, characterized inventory delta and current frame; retain the trace and post-action checkpoint
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Player placement and menu opening with server/client witnesses.
remaining_aspects: Input/recipe, processing, extraction and rejection/resource variants require other cases.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Use of the real queue and association of the menu with the server block.
remaining_aspects: Normal/shift/drag clicks, cursor and complete transactions still require additional cases.

scenarios.name: Input transfer through real slots
scenarios.setup_provenance: Pilot machine placed by SC-LAB-001 or a labeled fixture; starting items recorded and a valid recipe discovered.
sequence: p1: open the menu and identify slots using the effective layout
p1: click source and destination through the real Screen
barrier: server applies the transaction and client confirms slots/cursor
p1: attempt to insert an incompatible item into the same slot
barrier: record acceptance/rejection and complete states after the attempt
p1: close/reopen the menu and compare inventories
hypotheses_to_characterize: an incompatible item does not cause an unaccounted change
close/reopen does not duplicate the item or cursor stack
negative_controls: ACK without server application is insufficient
changing GUI scale without recalculating the target must expose an error
direct backend insertion cannot satisfy a slot action
scenarios.completion: server and client agree for every click, including the cursor, with the absence/presence of effects identified by Java
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Input insertion through the Screen and identification of recipe/slots.
remaining_aspects: Placement is composed with SC-LAB-001; processing and final extraction with SC-LAB-003; variants are not exhausted.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Normal click, cursor, incompatible-item attempt and close/reopen.
remaining_aspects: Shift-click, drag, split, full inventory and component combinations have not all been specified.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Slot/cursor transaction corroborated by server and client.
remaining_aspects: Other gestures, layouts and menus remain pending.

scenarios.name: Processing without energy and resumption
scenarios.setup_provenance: Recipe/input through the real menu; isolated administrative energy source, explicitly making no claim about a cable or generator.
sequence: p1: insert input and open the screen with known initial energy
clock: advance the window without supply and capture every tick
fixture: supply energy through the declared mechanism and record its effect
clock: advance to a bounded processing transition
p1: extract output through a slot and confirm inventory
hypotheses_to_characterize: lack of energy changes progress/consumption according to the reference
resumption must not be assumed to reset or preserve progress without observation
negative_controls: extra consumption in the trace must diverge
the same final output with a transient delay must diverge
a substituted energy unit must be rejected
scenarios.completion: no-energy→resumption→output trajectory characterized; no invented rate/quantity
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: No-energy trajectory, declared supply, processing and player extraction of output.
remaining_aspects: Depends on composition with placement/input and concrete recipes; full output and invalid input require their own cases.

scenarios.name: Full output blocks processing and clearing it releases processing
scenarios.setup_provenance: Full-output state constructed through recorded inventory actions or a declared owned checkpoint; sufficient energy observable.
sequence: p1: fill the output according to the real menu rules
p1: insert valid input
clock: capture resources and progress while blocked
p1: extract part of the output through a real click
clock: capture the unblocking and processing transition
p1: collect products and record the final balance
hypotheses_to_characterize: energy behavior while blocked is observed rather than assumed
partial output follows the real limit rule
negative_controls: omitting blocked ticks must invalidate the trace
duplicating extraction must change the balance and be detected
scenarios.completion: blocking and release have witnesses and complete balances, including transient behavior
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Full-output blocking, partial extraction and resumption with traces.
remaining_aspects: Does not cover all recipes, quantity boundaries, placement or invalid input.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Output occupancy and extraction through the real menu path.
remaining_aspects: Drag/shift/split gestures and components are not all exercised.

scenarios.name: Player-controlled redstone modes
scenarios.setup_provenance: Machine with known recipe/resources; lever and redstone path built in an original fixture and identified.
sequence: p1: choose a redstone mode in the menu
p1: operate the real lever using use input
barrier: server signal applied and client state updated
clock: observe progress/consumption under the signal
p1: invert the signal and repeat for the discovered modes
hypotheses_to_characterize: each mode has a real signal→activity table
a mode change during processing has its own transition
negative_controls: a changed signal with the wrong mode must diverge
a local menu change without server commit does not satisfy the step
scenarios.completion: per-mode table and signal transitions captured in Java with widget and machine identity
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Mode/signal table and lever transitions with server/client observation.
remaining_aspects: Short pulses and precise alignment to tick boundaries require concrete variants.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Mode/signal change while processing is active, with resources observed.
remaining_aspects: All pause/reset/consumption states depend on the reference; persistence is outside this design.

scenarios.name: Upgrade installation and removal
scenarios.setup_provenance: Pilot machine and valid upgrade discovered; fixed configuration profile.
sequence: clock: record baseline processing without an upgrade
p1: open the upgrades tab and insert the item through real slots
clock: wait for installation for the discovered duration and observe the count
clock: process a recipe under the new configuration
p1: remove the upgrade through the real control and record its return
clock: observe restoration of configuration and behavior
hypotheses_to_characterize: the upgrade effect depends on effective configuration
removal during processing follows the real rule
negative_controls: the comparator must not ignore an upgrade above the limit
removing an item without changing the observed module must diverge
scenarios.completion: baseline/installation/effect/removal have their own traces and no formula was derived from the future port
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Upgrade installation/removal through the interface and observation of its effect.
remaining_aspects: All upgrades/machine types, exceeded limits and configuration combinations require expansion.

scenarios.name: Save and reopen during processing
scenarios.setup_provenance: Machine demonstrably processing; the same world belongs exclusively to the lifecycle scenario.
sequence: clock: pause at the safe phase after processing starts
server: save and confirm durable flush
p1/server: disconnect and close gracefully
runner: start new processes with the owned saved world and identical lock
p1: reconnect, wait for chunks/menu and observe state
clock: advance continuation and extract output
hypotheses_to_characterize: actually persisted fields may differ from transient caches
continuation depends on the original saved state
negative_controls: loading an earlier save must fail on hash/state
restarting without flush ACK cannot satisfy the durable scenario
scenarios.completion: restart is real, all old processes are terminated and continuation characterizes persisted state without stale evidence
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Mid-process checkpoint, flush, new JVM, rejoin and subsequent ticks.
remaining_aspects: Start/end boundaries and crashes before/after durability still require separate cases.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Observed preservation of side configuration after restart.
remaining_aspects: Does not exercise configuration/rotation on all six faces or every mode.

scenarios.name: Placing and removing a cable splits the network
scenarios.setup_provenance: Source and consumers at original positions; connecting cable initially absent; quantities/tiers discovered.
sequence: p1: place the real connecting cable
barrier: topology/connection observed on the server and both clients
clock: capture distribution to consumers
p2: break the cable through the mining path
clock: capture the split and buffer effects
p1: replace the cable and observe the merge
hypotheses_to_characterize: distribution and retention on split follow the real priority
reconnection does not duplicate resources
negative_controls: the same global balance with a changed per-node distribution must diverge
stale geometry on p2 must fail the client witness
scenarios.completion: formation/split/merge produces authoritative and visual effects on both clients
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Place/remove a cable to separate/reunite nodes with observation from two clients.
remaining_aspects: Ring topology, merging occupied networks, per-node resources and chunk boundaries require variants.

scenarios.name: Chemical tank with an incompatible resource
scenarios.setup_provenance: Tank and source with observed chemical A; chemical B and container supplied through a declared original fixture; faces/modes identified.
sequence: p1: connect the tube through the chosen face and transfer A
p1: open the tank and observe type/quantity
p1: attempt to transfer B through the same path
clock: capture rejection or conversion according to the original
p1: use the Gauge Dropper through the screen and record extraction/insertion
hypotheses_to_characterize: mixing/rejection depends on the tank rule
the dropper preserves identity and quantity
negative_controls: changing the ID while retaining quantity must diverge
an empty tank and an absent field must not compare equal
scenarios.completion: each attempt has type/unit/quantity and an observed reaction, without normalizing chemicals by display name
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

scenarios.name: Sorter applies filters with a full destination
scenarios.setup_provenance: Layout with source, sorter, branch and two destinations; destinations built in an original fixture; filters not yet configured.
sequence: p1: create a filter in the menu with discovered parameters
p1: insert a batch with matching and nonmatching items
clock: observe destination selection and transit
p1: fill the preferred destination through the real inventory
clock: observe Java blocking/return/alternative route
p1: change filter order and repeat from reset state
hypotheses_to_characterize: filter order and color can change routing
item return cannot be assumed lossless without accounting
negative_controls: silently sorting filters must be detected
removing inflight state from the snapshot must invalidate completeness
scenarios.completion: configuration, transit and balances account for all items throughout execution
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Filters and full destination with observed route/transfer.
remaining_aspects: All item/tag/mod predicates, min/max/fuzzy/invert and overlapping priority require their own cases.

scenarios.name: Security between the owner and a second player
scenarios.setup_provenance: p1/p2 have distinct fixture aliases and UUIDs; storage owner established through the recorded real action.
sequence: p1: configure restricted mode in the menu
p2: attempt to open and transfer an item through real use
barrier: record server rejection/acceptance and p2's screen
p1: add p2 to the applicable trust mechanism
p2: repeat the action
p1: revoke access and have p2 repeat with the previously open menu
hypotheses_to_characterize: revocation with an open menu has its own rule
the same display name does not replace owner identity
negative_controls: changing owner/UUID while retaining the display name must diverge
visual success without server authorization does not pass
scenarios.completion: three access states and balances are observed by players and server
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Owner and second actor switch between stranger/trusted states and attempt real actions.
remaining_aspects: Three simultaneous identities, all operations and automation require a specific variant.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Revocation while the second actor had a menu open.
remaining_aspects: Persistence after restart and other access paths remain pending.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Opening/transfer in personal storage with allowed/denied permission.
remaining_aspects: All chests/barrels/portable items and automation access are not covered by this single design.

scenarios.name: QIO stores and returns items with components
scenarios.setup_provenance: Drive Array and frequency created in a traceable fixture; distinct drives and items available to the player; no unlabeled pre-injected QIO entries.
sequence: p1: install the drive and associate the dashboard with the frequency
p1: deposit component variants through the menu
p2: open the authorized dashboard and check the distinction
clock: schedule p1/p2 withdrawals in explicit order
server: save/restart and have clients reconnect
p1/p2: check the balance and withdraw the remainder
hypotheses_to_characterize: components distinguish types according to the real QIO rule
concurrent withdrawals follow authoritative order without ghost items
negative_controls: merging variants by item ID must diverge
a stale client count after withdrawal does not satisfy convergence
scenarios.completion: drive, dashboard and inventories account for each variant before/after restart
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Insertion/extraction of items with distinct components in QIO.
remaining_aspects: Type/quantity limits and all drive tiers still require boundary cases.

scenarios.name: Multiblock forms and invalidates through real construction
scenarios.setup_provenance: Original Dynamic Tank blueprint without a complete structure; player receives materials rather than an already formed controller.
sequence: p1: build the shell according to the blueprint through real placement
p1: place the final closing block
clock: observe the unformed→formed transition and capacity
p2: open the valve/menu and confirm the structure view
p1: break the designated structural block
clock: observe invalidation, contents and events on both clients
hypotheses_to_characterize: capacity and contents on invalidation follow Java
final placement must not be replaced with a pre-formed structure
negative_controls: removing the formation witness must prevent a pass
changing dimensions/capacity with the same contents must diverge
scenarios.completion: player-caused formation and invalidation have an authoritative trajectory and visual witness
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Player construction and valid/invalid multiblock transition.
remaining_aspects: Dimensional limits and adjacent structures are not yet concrete variants.

scenarios.name: Radiation and protection in an isolated area
scenarios.setup_provenance: Scratch world dedicated to global radiation; declared, bounded test source; p1/p2 with distinct equipment, never a personal world.
sequence: p1/p2: equip protection through real slots according to the variants
p1/p2: approach the area through real movement
clock: capture environment, dose and effects over a bounded window
p1: remove one piece and repeat controlled exposure
server: save/restart and observe environmental and personal persistence
hypotheses_to_characterize: partial protection may be nonlinear
persistence/decay must not be assumed
negative_controls: omitting personal dose while retaining environmental dose must invalidate the profile
normalizing health/dose with a global tolerance must be prohibited
scenarios.completion: exposure and protection are measured with a declared RNG/tick profile and isolated global state
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

scenarios.name: Equipment consumes a resource and switches mode
scenarios.setup_provenance: Equipment/installable module and resource supplied in starting inventory; player installs/equips; mode discovered at runtime.
sequence: p1: install the module and equip through the real path
p1: trigger the mode keybind and confirm HUD/server
p1: perform the bounded movement/use action
clock: capture position, resource and effects
p1: repeat without the resource and observe behavior
p1: open the GUI during use and observe input release
hypotheses_to_characterize: opening the GUI interacts with use/flight according to the original
lack of resource has a real effect on the mode
negative_controls: a keybind consumed by another screen must prevent the change claim
a client-only mode without server confirmation does not pass
scenarios.completion: mode, input, resources and movement are correlated in the real integrated instance
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

scenarios.name: Tool from Mekanism Tools breaks a block and loses durability
scenarios.setup_provenance: Test blocks and tool with discovered components; survival mode; no direct calls to server loot/break methods.
sequence: p1: select the tool in the hotbar and aim at the block
p1: hold attack until the break is observed
barrier: server removes the block and creates drops
p1: collect drops through real movement
p1: repeat on an incompatible block/class and with a tool near its limit
hypotheses_to_characterize: the paxel follows the correct abilities for each class
durability limit and drops depend on enchantments/conditions
negative_controls: correct final drops with incorrect mining/timing must diverge
omitted durability must block the requirement
scenarios.completion: breaking, loot, collection and durability have independent effects and traces for each variant
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

scenarios.name: Balloons attach to and detach from an entity
scenarios.setup_provenance: Fixture entity and balloon items in an isolated world; variant/color chosen by discovery, with no balloon already attached.
sequence: p1: use the balloon on the target with a real hit
barrier: server identifies the attachment and both clients apply it
clock: observe movement/physics over a bounded window
p2: perform the applicable detach/break action
clock: observe attachment removal, drops and client rendering
hypotheses_to_characterize: target support and physics are characterized
detach must not be assumed identical to killing the entity
negative_controls: an attachment changed to another entity must diverge
a screenshot alone without authoritative attachment does not pass
scenarios.completion: real attach/motion/detach is observed on the server and two clients without arbitrarily equating ephemeral IDs
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

scenarios.name: Late join and reconnection to a machine in use
scenarios.setup_provenance: p1 starts processing and keeps the menu open; p2 is still disconnected; separate identities/menus.
sequence: p1: start processing and open the menu
runner/p2: start a new client and join the server
p2: open the same machine and check the initial state received
p2: start a transfer and disconnect at the declared boundary
server: record whether the action was applied or rejected
p2: reconnect with its identity and compare inventory/menu with the server
hypotheses_to_characterize: an action at disconnect may commit or be rejected depending on the boundary
late-join initial state is current
negative_controls: a lost ACK does not authorize blind transfer replay
using p1's UUID for p2 must fail identity validation
scenarios.completion: the action outcome is accounted for once and both views converge without reusing the previous menu cache
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Two viewers of the same machine, late join and reconnect with separate menus.
remaining_aspects: All concurrent settings and process edits need a specific schedule.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Second-player transaction with disconnect at the boundary and a single outcome.
remaining_aspects: A concurrent hopper, block removal and all contention schedules are not exercised.

scenarios.name: Network crosses a chunk boundary and resumes after unload
scenarios.setup_provenance: Original network crosses a known chunk boundary; explicit tickets and stabilizer absent/present in separate variants.
sequence: p1: form the connection and confirm consumption on both sides
p1: move away to allow unload under the declared policy
barrier: server confirms real unload, not merely visual absence
clock: capture still-loaded nodes and persisted data
p1: return and wait for the chunk to be applied
clock: observe reconstruction/resumption and repeat with the stabilizer configured
hypotheses_to_characterize: unload may change distribution and timing
the stabilizer maintains only the defined tickets
negative_controls: visual teleport without unload does not satisfy the case
comparing only loaded nodes and deleting the others is invalid
scenarios.completion: server-proven lifecycle with accounting across saved and live state
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Network crossing a chunk boundary with unload/reload and observed resumption.
remaining_aspects: Persistence on restart and all tickets/reload orders require variants where not described.

scenarios.name: Quantum Entangloporter connects a frequency across dimensions
scenarios.setup_provenance: Two entangloporters in distinct dimensions, original world data and known owners; frequency not yet associated.
sequence: p1/p2: open their respective real menus
p1: create a frequency and have p2 select the same one with permission
p1/p2: configure input/output faces through the GUI
clock: observe the supported resource being transferred and shared
p2: change the frequency and observe disconnection
server: save/restart and have clients verify the association
hypotheses_to_characterize: frequencies with the same name may depend on owner/public visibility
resource classes have their own transfer behavior
negative_controls: normalizing names and merging distinct frequencies must diverge
an omitted dimension makes identity ambiguous and must fail
scenarios.completion: association/disassociation and persistence account for resource and identity across both dimensions
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Frequency across dimensions and owners with real endpoints.
remaining_aspects: All same-name public/private pairs and all dimensions still require expansion.

scenarios.name: Real generator powers a machine through the network
scenarios.setup_provenance: Fuel source/environmental condition defined by discovery; generator/cable/machine placed by the player, without backend energy during measurement.
sequence: p1: place the generator, cable and machine through real input
p1: supply fuel/resource through the applicable menu
p1: insert the machine input
clock: capture generation, buffers, transfer and consumption
p1: interrupt the generator supply
clock: observe depletion and stopping/resumption when supply is restored
hypotheses_to_characterize: the chain has real buffers and rounding
accounting considers generation, consumption and valid losses
negative_controls: fixture-injected energy invalidates the end-to-end chain claim
equal final consumption with false generation must diverge
scenarios.completion: the operational chain originates from real actions and each source/sink is observed per tick
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Real generator connects through the network to a consumer with energy observed.
remaining_aspects: All fuels/thermal environments and cubes/demand limits remain pending.

scenarios.name: Digital Miner filters, mines and replaces a block
scenarios.setup_provenance: Small original area with target/nontarget blocks and a known boundary; miner assembled and resources available; no calls to an internal mining method.
sequence: p1: configure boundaries and filter through the menu
p1: start the search and record the discovered set/count
p1: start mining with observable resources
clock: record each block change and inventories
p1: enable the replacement policy and remove required material in a variant
clock: observe blocking/continuation and the area's final contents
hypotheses_to_characterize: filter selection and replacement follow real order/semantics
lack of material is not equivalent to ignoring the policy
negative_controls: the same output with a nontarget block destroyed must diverge
a position missing from the trace invalidates the world diff
scenarios.completion: every world selection and change has a position, reason, inventory/energy effect and client witness
scenarios.actor_policy: Distinct aliases and identities; instantiate additional actors when owner/trusted/stranger roles are required.

aspects_exercised_by_design: Digital Miner uses filters/mining/replacement on a known layout.
remaining_aspects: Inverse filter, all predicates, permission and area boundaries require variants.

scenario_mapping_policy: Manual aspect-level links are reviewed_partial_design; remaining_aspects retains gaps. Composition does not equal executed coverage. requirement_refs indexes these links, never a crossjoin through the parent.
